def construction (p : Program) (r k : ℕ) : NM NForm := do
  let a := inputs k
  let zero ← constant 0
  let one ← constant 1
  let q ← fresh
  let c ← fresh
  let K ← fresh
  let B ← fresh
  let T ← fresh
  let F ← fresh
  let D ← fresh
  let R ← freshN r
  let N ← freshN r
  let S ← freshN p.length
  let φs ← packedFormulas p r a zero one q c K B T F D R N S
  pure (.and φs)
